title: Scripts and CLI Governance Unification Scope v1
principle: Gate mutations without breaking legitimate read-only, report, docs, and validation workflows. Unify on dry-run-by-default for all mutation scripts. Require structured JSON output for all scripts. Integrate all mutation scripts with governance engine.

proposed_dry_run_defaults.principle: All mutation-capable scripts must default to dry-run. Mutation occurs only with explicit --execute or --confirm flag.
required_for: all scripts in lifecycle, provider, release, migration, admin families

proposed_structured_output_contract.principle: All scripts must produce structured JSON output on --json flag. Console output is for humans; --json is for pipeline/audit.

no_overrun_guards: Do not implement governance runtime fixes — this mission is inventory only
Do not modify scripts during this mission — classification only
Do not refactor CLI entrypoints — gating comes in a follow-up slice
Do not delete or rename scripts — taxonomy is additive
Do not add dependencies — all gating uses existing canonical dependencies
Do not gate read-only scripts — 93 scripts must continue to work without governance overhead
Do not break GitHub workflows — CI, release, and pages workflows are out of scope for CLI governance unification
